288/1226
Platforms: Linux, macOS, Windows
This event is generated when an executable file extension is written, whether or not it is truly an executable file type. Any file that ends with a known
executable file extension (e.g. .exe, .bat, .scr) will generate this event.
The difference between a NewExecutableWritten event and PeFileWritten is that NewExecutableWritten looks for the extension of a file
written, while PEFileWritten looks for the PE header in a file that was written.
